router.config:
# thunder-agent gate as in PR3 (llm-d/llm-d-router#3076, image
# llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:thunder-agent-pr3-a025437b). Same pipeline as
# deploy/config/thunderagent-config.yaml in that branch, with capacityTokens set
# to this pool's real KV size (the fallback when cache_config_info is absent).
# Step 25: 1667712 = 26058 GPU blocks x 64, the smallest pool seen across the
# B200 restarts (1667712 to 1694080 tokens).
# Endpoints come from a file (file-discovery: no Kubernetes API, so no RBAC,
# which our account cannot create on a4-pr). The file lists the vLLM Service
# ClusterIP, stable across the per-point restarts of the single vLLM pod.
# Timeouts: the 1800 s backstop needs defaultRequestTTL 0 (no queue eviction),
# envoy ext_proc message_timeout above 1800 s (2400 s in the lane values), and a
# client that waits longer than that. PR3's own default backstop is 30 s, below
# the 60 s default TTL; if you use it, drop defaultRequestTTL and say so.
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
featureGates:
- flowControl
plugins:
- name: vllm-endpoints
  type: file-discovery
  parameters:
    path: /config/endpoints.yaml
    watchFile: true
- type: agent-identity
  parameters:
    additionalSessionHeaders:
    - x-session-id
- type: thunder-agent
  name: thunder
  parameters:
    capacityTokens: 1667712
    utilThreshold: 1.0
    idleLeaseSeconds: 30
    headWaitStarvationMs: 1800000
    evictionTtlSeconds: 3600
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
flowControl:
  defaultRequestTTL: "0s"
  saturationDetector:
    pluginRef: thunder
  defaultPriorityBand:
    fairnessPolicyRef: thunder
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: thunder
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
dataLayer:
  discovery:
    endpoints:
      pluginRef: vllm-endpoints

router.config:
# Variant thunder-cpu-l10: the gate's capacity counts vLLM's CPU KV tier and the
# idle lease is 10 s (about the p84 of per-session gaps at c=16; 30 s is p88).
# The vLLM engine config below drops cacheInfoSpec, so the gate cannot read the
# GPU block count and falls back to capacityTokens:
#   3909360 = 1639360 GPU tokens (c=16 restart) + 2270000 CPU tier tokens
#   (820 GiB / 8 ranks = 102.5 GiB per rank at about 48.4 KB per token per rank,
#   the GPU pool's bytes per token).
#
# thunder-agent gate as in PR3 (llm-d/llm-d-router#3076, image
# llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:thunder-agent-pr3-a025437b-produces, PR3 plus the
# Produces() fix). Same pipeline as
# deploy/config/thunderagent-config.yaml in that branch, with capacityTokens set
# to this pool's real KV size (the fallback when cache_config_info is absent).
# Step 25: 1667712 = 26058 GPU blocks x 64, the smallest pool seen across the
# B200 restarts (1667712 to 1694080 tokens).
# Endpoints come from a file (file-discovery: no Kubernetes API, so no RBAC,
# which our account cannot create on a4-pr). The file lists the vLLM Service
# ClusterIP, stable across the per-point restarts of the single vLLM pod.
# Timeouts: the 1800 s backstop needs defaultRequestTTL 0 (no queue eviction),
# envoy ext_proc message_timeout above 1800 s (2400 s in the lane values), and a
# client that waits longer than that. PR3's own default backstop is 30 s, below
# the 60 s default TTL; if you use it, drop defaultRequestTTL and say so.
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
featureGates:
- flowControl
plugins:
- name: vllm-endpoints
  type: file-discovery
  parameters:
    path: /config/endpoints.yaml
    watchFile: true
- type: metrics-data-source
  parameters:
    scheme: http
    path: /metrics
- type: core-metrics-extractor
  parameters:
    defaultEngine: vllm-no-cacheinfo
    engineConfigs:
    - name: vllm-no-cacheinfo
      queuedRequestsSpec: vllm:num_requests_waiting
      runningRequestsSpec: vllm:num_requests_running
      kvUsageSpec: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc
      loraSpec: vllm:lora_requests_info
- type: agent-identity
  parameters:
    additionalSessionHeaders:
    - x-session-id
- type: thunder-agent
  name: thunder
  parameters:
    capacityTokens: 3909360
    utilThreshold: 1.0
    idleLeaseSeconds: 10
    headWaitStarvationMs: 1800000
    evictionTtlSeconds: 3600
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
flowControl:
  defaultRequestTTL: "0s"
  saturationDetector:
    pluginRef: thunder
  defaultPriorityBand:
    fairnessPolicyRef: thunder
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: thunder
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
dataLayer:
  sources:
  - pluginRef: metrics-data-source
    extractors:
    - pluginRef: core-metrics-extractor
  discovery:
    endpoints:
      pluginRef: vllm-endpoints
